hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a custom bonding-curve AMM backed by Euler lending vaults. In beforeSwap, it computes swap amounts via a custom curve (CurveLib), deposits input tokens into one Euler vault and withdraws output tokens from another, fully replacing Uniswap's concentrated liquidity mechanism with single-sided vault-backed liquidity.
